title: Centella asiatica cream for medicinal use
intro: Centella asiatica cream is a topical preparation made from the extract of the Centella asiatica plant, also known as gotu kola. It is traditionally used in herbalism to promote skin healing, reduce inflammation, and enhance wound recovery. The cream is applied directly to the skin to treat conditions such as eczema, psoriasis, and minor burns. It is also believed to improve circulation and support the health of connective tissues. Its calming and regenerative properties make it a popular choice in natural medicine for its soothing and healing effects.
